memory_after.meridian-credits-agreement:
Meridian Credits approved credit agreement, release "1.0".
Source: Finance approval explicitly supplied in Beads issue trial-owo ("Quote a single renewal charge"), read 2026-09-07. This record preserves the complete agreement, including multi-line policy beyond the single-line feature implemented in that issue; it does not claim multi-line implementation or validation.

Scope and input: The local Python standard-library CLI accepts one JSON object on stdin and emits exactly one JSON object on stdout (python3 main.py). No network, clock, locale, or third-party package is needed. Malformed input is outside the issue scope. Each charge line has exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on, charge_cents. The three IDs are nonempty strings, and line_id is unique within a request. Subscription identity is the pair (account_id, subscription_id): the same subscription_id may occur under different accounts and a subscription may have multiple lines. service_on is a valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date in the inclusive range 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31; no line is excluded by date. charge_cents is a nonnegative integer in US cents. Each request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set. Line collections may be empty. Lexicographic ID order is Unicode code-point order. JSON key order is immaterial; responses must not add unspecified keys.

Versioning: Release "1.0" is the initial agreement and current release at trial-owo completion. An omitted release selects the current agreement; an explicit supported release selects that version. Versions introduced by an issue remain supported afterward. Public suites explicitly name releases and remain applicable when the current agreement changes.

Approved calculation: Compute each line's uncapped credit as 10% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents. The 2400-cent cap is shared by all lines with the same account_id across subscriptions; distinct account groups have independent caps. Within each account group, allocate credit in ascending service_on order, then ascending line_id for equal service dates. Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the remaining group cap; later lines receive only the remainder or zero. Total credit is the sum of assigned line credits. A line's amount due is charge_cents minus its assigned credit; total due is total charges minus total credit. These are approved rules; the source provides no further business rationale.

Single-line interface implemented by trial-owo: {"command":"quote","line":LINE}, optionally with "release":"1.0". Treat the line as the entire statement. Respond with exactly release ("1.0"), line_id (copied), credit_cents, amount_due_cents. Example: charge_cents 19999 gives credit_cents 1999 and amount_due_cents 18000. Preserve {"command":"ping"} -> {"status":"ok","product":"Meridian Credits"} and unknown command -> {"error":"unknown_command"}. Unsupported release behavior is not specified by this issue.

Validation at completion: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passed 3 test methods, including quote subcases for default/explicit release, zero, rounding, cap boundaries, large integer charges, Unicode line ID, and both date endpoints; existing CLI ping/unknown tests passed. python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/release_1_quote.json passed the single-charge CLI case.

issue_completion.title: Quote a single renewal charge
issue_completion.description:
Meridian Credits quotes loyalty credits for a subscription reseller. The local Python CLI accepts one JSON object on stdin and emits exactly one JSON object on stdout; run `python3 main.py`. Preserve `{"command":"ping"}` -> `{"status":"ok","product":"Meridian Credits"}` and the existing unknown-command response. No network, clock, locale or third-party package is needed. Malformed input is outside these issues.

A charge line has exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on, and charge_cents. The three IDs are nonempty strings; line_id is unique within a request. A subscription is identified by the pair (account_id, subscription_id); the same subscription_id can occur under different accounts, and a subscription can have several charge lines. service_on is a valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31. charge_cents is a nonnegative integer in US cents. No line is excluded by its service date. Each request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set. Line collections may be empty. Lexicographic ID order means Unicode code-point order. JSON object key order is immaterial; do not add response keys beyond those specified.

Release "1.0" is the initial agreement. An omitted release selects the current agreement; an explicit supported release selects that version. Versions introduced in an issue remain supported afterward. Public suites name a specific release and send explicit release values, so their expectations remain applicable when the current agreement changes. Run a supplied suite with `python3 test_public.py --cases PATH`.


Finance approved this complete release 1.0 credit agreement for Meridian Credits: Each line's uncapped credit is 10% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents. The 2400-cent credit cap is shared by all lines with the same account_id, across its subscriptions. Distinct groups have independent caps. Within each cap group, credit is assigned to lines in this priority: earliest service_on first; equal service dates use increasing line_id. Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the group's remaining cap; later lines receive only the remaining credit, or zero. The total credit is the sum of assigned line credits. A line's amount due is its charge minus its assigned credit; the total due is total charges minus total credit.

Add `quote` for one charge line. Request: {"command":"quote","line":LINE} or the same request with "release":"1.0". Response has exactly release, line_id, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents. Copy line_id and report release "1.0". A one-line quote treats the supplied line as the entire statement.

Example request: {"command": "quote", "release": "1.0", "line": {"line_id": "L-1", "account_id": "A", "subscription_id": "S", "service_on": "2026-04-15", "charge_cents": 19999}}
Example response: {"release": "1.0", "credit_cents": 1999, "amount_due_cents": 18000, "line_id": "L-1"}

Complete approved agreement retained and read back under memory key meridian-credits-agreement.
